verses: O fell not that sweet pear tree! See how its branches spread. Spoil not its shade, For Shao's chief laid Beneath it his weary head.
O clip not that sweet pear tree! Each twig and leaflet spare. 'Tis sacred now, Since the lord of Shao, When weary, rested him there.
O touch not that sweet pear tree! Bend not a twig of it now. There long ago, As the stories show, Oft halted the chief of Shao.
